camel_example: aliyun bssopenapi CreateInstance --region cn-hangzhou --SubscriptionType Subscription --ProductCode Cdn
description_en: Creates an instance resource. This operation creates an order for a new instance resource and completes automatic payment. ECS and RDS product series are not supported
description_zh: 创建一个实例资源，会创建一个新购实例资源的订单，并自动支付。不支持ECS和RDS系列产品的创建
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi create-instance --product-code Cdn --subscription-type Subscription --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en: The product code. You can call the QueryProductList operation to query the product code
parameters.help_zh: 产品代码。可通过接口QueryProductList查询产品代码
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
Subscription: subscription.
PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值：
Subscription：预付费。
PayAsYouGo：后付费
parameters.name: subscription_type

parameters.help_en: The subscription period. Unit: months. For yearly subscription products, specify a multiple of 12
parameters.help_zh: 预付费周期。单位为月，按年付费产品请输入12的整数倍
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal status. Valid values:
AutoRenewal: auto-renewal is enabled.
ManualRenewal: manual renewal.

Default value: ManualRenewal
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费状态，取值：
AutoRenewal：自动续费。
ManualRenewal：手动续费。

默认ManualRenewal
parameters.name: renewal_status

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal epoch. Unit: months.
This parameter is required when you set RenewalStatus to AutoRenewal in Settings
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期， 单位为月。
当设置RenewalStatus为AutoRenewal时，必须设置
parameters.name: renew_period

parameters.help_en: The client idempotency token. The server checks whether a request with the same ClientToken has been made. If yes, the server returns the result of the previous call
parameters.help_zh: 客户端幂等参数，服务端会查询是否有相同ClientToken的请求，如果有，直接返回上次调用结果
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_zh: 本次订单的物流信息地址，一般对实物类订单有效
parameters.name: logistics

fields.help_en: The code of the Nth module property. Valid values of N: 1 to 100. If multiple module properties exist, concatenate them in the format of N=1, 2, 3...N
fields.help_zh: 第n个模块属性code配置，n的取值范围为（1~100），如有多个模块属性参数，按照n=1,2,3…n的形式拼接多个参数
fields.name: code

fields.help_en: The value of the Nth module property. Valid values of N: 1 to 100
fields.help_zh: 第n个模块属性value配置，n的取值范围为（1~100）
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription period.

PricingCycle=1: The unit of the subscription period is year.

PricingCycle=2: The unit of the subscription period is month.

PricingCycle=3: The unit of the subscription period is day.

Default value: PricingCycle=2.

This parameter is applicable only to specific product types (ProductType is ddos_originpre_public_cn, ddosDip, ddoscoo, ddos_originpre_public_intl, ddosDip_intl, or ddoscoo_intl)
parameters.help_zh:
预付费周期的周期类型

PricingCycle=1-表示预付费周期的单位是年；

PricingCycle=2-表示预付费周期的单位是月；

PricingCycle=3-表示预付费周期的单位是天；

默认值：PricingCycle=2

仅限于部分产品类型使用（ProductType为ddos_originpre_public_cn、ddosDip、ddoscoo、ddos_originpre_public_intl、ddosDip_intl、ddoscoo_intl）
parameters.name: pricing_cycle
